plugins.name: dev-day
plugins.description: Developer day-loop: session bootstrap with feedback memory + plan-gate, Jira standup/triage/groom/create, clean Jira comments, and end-of-day learning capture.

plugins.name: tdd-pipeline
plugins.description: Gated TDD build pipeline, ticket to Done: /build plans with click-approval; /implement runs test-writer → implementer → test-runner → multi-specialist review (security, quality, money-logic, concurrency) → changelog; /ship verifies the build receipt, then branches, commits, pushes and opens the PR, moving the ticket to In Review; /merged verifies the merge, parks the ticket for validation and cleans up branches; /validated records your sign-off and closes it. Jira optional; nothing hardcoded.
